reviewer: desktop_qa independent QA agent; not independent human reviewers

rubric.adequate: Core requested factual and scope conclusions are supplied without a material semantic error; format/source checks remain separate.
rubric.partial: Some useful content, but a required result is missing or a qualification/correction is needed.
rubric.incorrect: Contains a material mathematical, calendar-identity or source interpretation error.
rubric.countsUse: Convenience-sample case dispositions only. Do not interpret these counts as general accuracy or a validated model-ranking score.

cases.review: Reports 96.88 days later; independent arithmetic gives 9.688 days earlier. Correctly withholds a personal-danger conclusion. Structured citation invents EVAL-H00-S1 despite a valid inline H01 marker.
Correctly explains a two-day correlation difference, but leaves variable formulas instead of the requested concrete JDN values 1,970,761 and 1,970,763.
Correct Julian-valid/Gregorian-invalid distinction, century exception and explicit request for the missing calendar convention; no silent normalization.
A is correctly Krittika/index3/pada4. B is incorrectly Bharani/index2 rather than Rohini/index4/pada1 at the exact 40-degree boundary.
Correctly refuses merging and explains the leap flag, yet its minimum-identity sentence lists only year/month/day, omitting the very flag needed to distinguish records.
Correctly gives Tishri under Nisan-first and AdarII under the stipulated Tishri-first scheme, and refuses a unique Gregorian date without the scheme.
Retains circle/centralpoint, lunar semicircle and right-angled cross; rejects unsupported triangle/pentagram additions and personal prediction claims.
Correct reader authorship, alternative reflection label and no diagnosis/destiny. Adds unsupported psychological-projection speculation; useful core answer still needs editing.
Reports 0.2422 days earlier: uses the one-year difference rather than forty periods. Correctly withholds a dangerous-day conclusion.
Computes the correlation difference of2 but repeats the dashboard arithmetic-contradiction claim rather than rejecting it; omits both required JDN values.

Correct validity in each calendar and refusal of silent normalization, but does not explicitly tell the importer to obtain the missing calendar convention. No Gregorian century-rule explanation is supplied.
Lists all four supplied nakshatra names for both points; does not actually classify A/B or report their padas. Name presence is not a successful answer.
Contradicts itself about leap-month identity, says the leap marker is not used for the date and its known status is unknown; minimum fields omit the marker.
Malformed JSON even after removing outer fences. Human reading also finds omitted Tishri alternative, irrelevant month list and false permission for a unique Gregorian date.

Restores lunar semicircle and right-angled cross and limits predictive claims, but omits the central point in its renderer instruction and does not explicitly classify the triangle/pentagram as adaptations.

Attributes sentences to the present-day reader, offers Reader Reflection and rejects diagnosis/destiny. Wording authentic quotation by a reader is awkward, but it does not misattribute them to Jung/Plato.

r3Confounds: Prompt, retrieval settings, target text, learning rate and reset checkpoint differ.

4B uses JSON grammar, HF adapter does not; BF16 versus quantized inference differ.
Fixed supplied source packets test generation, not live retrieval quality.
developmentReview.challenger: Two Qwen3.5 outputs give core D05/D09 distinctions, but D05 also has the computedPartition helper; D09 grounding paraphrases lots selecting lives whereas the source says order of choosing. Two cases do not establish a superior general model.

evaluationAudit: No exact heldout-question duplicates or shared five-word shingles were found against training/development questions; this does not prove semantic/pretraining independence.
Regex name-presence signals can credit a list without a classification; H04 adapter illustrates this.
Exact quotes can accompany wrong claims; H01/H04 4B illustrate this.
Only outer Markdown fences are removed for normalized-content evaluation; malformed H06 adapter receives no parsed-content credit.
Numerical pattern signals do not implement tolerance arithmetic or semantic entailment.
decision: Keep local source excerpts as the browser default. Optional4B drafts need source and arithmetic review. Do not promote the trained0.6B adapter or two-case3.5 challenger as validated reading engines.
limits: Eight deliberately selected heterogeneous scenarios, one generation per configuration, no repeated seeds or confidence intervals.
No full-book coverage, personal chart training, forecast or life-outcome validation.
A real nonzero LoRA weight update and reload prove training execution, not quality improvement.
These are reviews by another model agent, not an independent human expert study.
